# mtncloud_tenant_role (Data Source)

Master tenant only: customer (sub-tenant) logins get 403 from the API it uses. Looks up a tenant role by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_tenant_role" "example_tenant_role" {
  name = "Tenant Admin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the MTN Cloud tenant role.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
